evidence: Validation label and changes to src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp affecting block index management, unlinked block tracking, and block index candidate sets.
rationale: Fixes assertion crashes and data structure corruption in the block index. As noted in the description, mutating `nSequenceId` while in `setBlockIndexCandidates` corrupts set ordering and causes lookups to fail, while unlinking pruned blocks causes assertion failures in `CheckBlockIndex` and node inconsistency (closing issues #31512 and #36021).
